caption_L1: This is a line graph called Number of venture capital funds in the United Kingdom (UK) from 2007 to 2016 , by funding stage. A linear scale from 0 to 14 can be seen on the y-axis, marked Early stage. There is a linear scale with a minimum of 2008 and a maximum of 2014 along the x-axis, labeled Year.
caption_L2L3: Between 2007 and 2013 we see some fluctuations year on year in number of venture capital funds in the UK. During this period there seems to be a trend of increasing one year (e.g. from 8 in 2007 to 11 in 2008) and decreasing the next (e.g from 11 in 2008 to 7 in 2009). The overall trend during this period however is a gradual decline in funds. We then see a huge increase in 2014 where the number spikes at 14, before reapidly declining with only 2 funds in the UK in 2016.
